title: No conflation of walls
statement: RH != PNT-error != off-diagonal != parity. These four walls are distinct and must never be merged.

title: Adversarial PVG-ANT Benchmark 002 protocol
statement: Two hidden sets (A development, B sealed generalization), four separated roles, frozen execution config, B0/B1/B2 tiers, four primary ablation arms, frozen rubric with abstention scoring, conceptual leakage screen, binding sequence ending in one single B run. S1 IN_PROGRESS: STEP A authored and machine-validated (48 cases, frozen matrix met); STEP B NOT_STARTED (no B artifact exists). Set-A concealment was defective at the staging commit and is contained by environment pin, not by re-authoring (NEG-BENCH002-HIDDEN-A-CONTAINMENT-001). G1 sealing not reached. Parent PVG-ANT-CENTRAL-MIND-MATURATION-002; not a research goal.
